rules.text: **Home-base header:** product logo/lockup left, icon actions right.

**Logo lockup size and place.** Every home-base screen with the "truemeds for doctors" lockup (`foundation/logo/truemeds-for-doctors.svg`, project level, §2.8) draws it **166px wide** (height follows the 220×54 artwork), **16px from the top**, and the logo→title gap stays as in §8.3 (L6). Nothing else sets the lockup size.
L6 — Sign-in logo-to-title gap: 48 (`--tm-space-3xl`), home-base hero gap.

**Logo: LOCKED. Use the official files in; never redraw, recolour, stretch, crop or hotlink them.** `truemeds-logo.svg` is the full logo and is the primary logo; Product-specific lockups (for example the Doctor app's "truemeds for doctors") are NOT design-system files: they live in their own project, must embed `truemeds-logo.svg` unchanged, and carry their own lock check. `truemeds-icon.svg` is the icon-only mark (70x70, shape from the Truemeds-LOGO Figma file, https://www.figma.com/design/nD1pPa1SMzuZKnJIZxCdKa/Truemeds-LOGO) for favicons, avatars and tight spaces. **Colours are fixed: logo blue `#1B69DE` and logo green `#22B573`, in every logo file.** (The Figma file's older blue `#0071BC` is not used.) These are logo colours only; UI colour still comes from tokens. Reference with. Lock: holds each file's sha256; must pass before any commit that touches.
